Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L04_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.06

Word origins and derivations item 1: Which choice best uses word-family knowledge for speech vocabulary?

answer.text: A. Guess the meaning from sound alone

feedback.text: This choice is too vague or informal for the speech purpose. Choose language that supports audience understanding.

answer.text: B. Use the same word form in every sentence

feedback.text: This choice may sound related, but it does not show precise vocabulary control for communication.

answer.text: C. Use related word forms correctly in a speech sentence

feedback.text: Correct. This choice uses vocabulary knowledge to make the speech clearer, more precise, and appropriate for the audience.

answer.text: D. Choose a made-up word form

feedback.text: This choice weakens the speech because it does not make the speaker language clearer or more precise.
